markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn

Single-class conformal set, both models agree, and the input looks typical [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, others 0% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 30th percentile | Typical, unflagged [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, Invasive | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · Largest concept-model term; above typical [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored high, but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical in these regions [F4] · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; this case leans on mitoses (Unreliable).

## Could be wrong if
- The stain degradation (simulated, severity 3) hides or mimics features; reliability only weakly ranks errors (AUROC 0.69).
- In situ disease mimics invasion; the in situ concept passed only 12/20 spot checks.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 4**: confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma rather than stay confined to ducts.
2. **Regions 2, 6, 9**: verify nuclear pleomorphism directly; mitosis and necrosis scores are unreliable.
3. **Regions 0, 7**: lowest-scoring margin segments; confirm the tumor-at-margin call [F7].
